title: Probing Intersectional Biases in Vision-Language Models with Counterfactual Examples

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image retrieval skew (MaxSkew@K) in Vision-Language Models using generated synthetic counterfactual image-text pairs that depict the same subject (e.g., occupations) but differ only in racial attributes.
